Key Foley clips are adapted from these Freesound recordings, all CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

throw.wav: quick woosh by florianreichelt
https://freesound.org/people/florianreichelt/sounds/683101/

pickup.wav: Keys_pickup_5.wav by cribbler
https://freesound.org/people/cribbler/sounds/440439/

impact-wood.wav and impact-rug.wav: Metal Trinket Fall 4.mp3 by Pancakebees
https://freesound.org/people/Pancakebees/sounds/706843/

key-shine.wav and row-bells.wav: Small bell by Throndronis
https://freesound.org/people/Throndronis/sounds/799520/
The first strike is from approximately 14.45 s. In row-bells.wav three pitched copies form the following chime.

The clips are trimmed, downmixed and gain-adjusted. The rug impact is low-pass filtered.
